citationText: 6. U.S. Pat. 1145132, filed by C. H. Florian, 1913 . The Petzval sum is a measure of the intrinsic field curvature of a lens, and only by reducing this sum can an anstigmatic flat field be obtained. This is usually accomplished by incorporating into the lens some elements with positive power and some with about the same amount of negative power.
